title: Synapse runtime tuning
description: Non-secret memory-recall and realtime-outbox tuning knobs. Optional: any knob left unset keeps its built-in default. Loaded from packages/api/config/runtime-tuning.json (or RUNTIME_TUNING_CONFIG_PATH); a matching env var (e.g. MEMORY_MMR_LAMBDA) overrides the file value.

recallLimit.description: How many memories a recall returns to the model. Default 6.

searchCandidateLimit.description: Candidate pool size fetched before ranking/MMR trims to the recall limit. Default 40.

recallTopK.description: Override for the reranker's top-K; when unset it follows recallLimit. Default: recallLimit.

mmrLambda.description: MMR diversity weight in [0,1]: higher favors relevance, lower favors diversity. Default 0.8.

mmrCandidateMultiplier.description: MMR considers mmrCandidateMultiplier × recall-limit candidates. Default 4.

summaryDecayHalfLifeDays.description: Half-life (days) of the recency decay applied to summary relevance. Default 30.

summaryDecayFloor.description: Lower bound in [0,1] the recency-decay multiplier never drops below. Default 0.35.

batchSize.description: Rows the realtime-outbox dispatcher claims per poll. Default 100.

pollMs.description: Dispatcher poll interval in ms. Default 500.

retentionHours.description: Hours dispatched outbox rows are kept for debugging before GC (0 = delete on dispatch). Default 24.

gcIntervalMs.description: How often the dispatcher runs its GC sweep, in ms. Default 60000.

processingTimeoutMs.description: How long a row may sit in 'processing' before it is treated as abandoned and reclaimed, in ms. Must exceed worst-case publish latency. Default 30000.
